note: Suave music segments, cut from 'Elvis Crespo - Suavemente.mp3' (not shipped; non-released showcase). Beat grid from suave/anim/work/bpm.json: t = first_beat_s + beat x beat_period_s, downbeats every 4 beats from beat 0. Each segment starts on a downbeat (a 0.25 s fade-in) and lasts 36 beats (9 bars, 17.4 s): the 6-beat intro, the 19-beat dance to the release, the push and the dive with the explosion in the air (about beat 32), then the tail. One segment per partner type (TODGameplay.ini [suave] music_soldier / music_civil / music_dea / music_other). Starts picked from analyze_song.py (loudness, band balance, onset strength); change start_beat here after listening and rerun make_segments.py.
